purpose: Discovery baseline: relevant questions asked to search-backed assistants WITHOUT naming FinanceRateCalc. Records whether FRC pages appear among sources, whether the number is right, and whether qualifiers survive. Repeated in November with the same questions.

probes.question: What is the FHA annual mortgage insurance premium for a $300,000 loan at 85% LTV with a 15-year term, case number assigned in 2026? Give the exact rate, the HUD document it comes from, and the table cell it matches.
probes.note: The answer opened with the neighbouring cell (0.40%) in bold and corrected itself mid-answer; a reader who stops at the first paragraph leaves with the wrong number. Same pattern as the Stale Rule Index no-source condition. Asked by the publisher; recorded as the baseline before any discovery effect could appear (pages published 2026-10-11).
